research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Mainspring Energy is researching linear generator systems, as described in titles such as 'A linear generator system' and 'Integrated linear generator system,' focusing on integrating generator assemblies, control, exhaust, intake, and cooling systems. Efforts include controlling piston trajectory, energy storage and conversion, and synchronization of multiple linear generators. Additional work addresses ammonia fuel use, high-power core systems, and advanced sealing and bearing assemblies for efficient power generation.

product_launches.description: Mainspring Energy is deploying its Mainspring Linear Generator in a U.S. Air Force pilot project at Travis Air Force Base to demonstrate multi-fuel, resilient on-site power generation.

overview_description.description: Mainspring Energy develops and manufactures linear generators that convert fuel into electricity. The company focuses on providing clean energy solutions that enhance power generation efficiency. Its technology is designed to support various applications, including onsite power generation. Mainspring Energy emphasizes sustainability and aims to contribute to the transition to cleaner energy sources. Through its innovative approach, the company seeks to meet the growing demand for flexible and environmentally friendly energy solutions. Partnerships with other organizations further expand its capabilities in delivering effective energy systems.
